audit_scope: RCA-2A.7 runner, harness, diagnostic sink, cross-arm fixtures

defects.name: Runner Seat Record Parameter Passing Omission
defects.required_change: Introduce explicit SeatExecutionContext dataclass tracking lifecycle phases (NOT_STARTED, INPUT_VERIFIED, INVOCATION_STARTED, INVOCATION_FINISHED, RESULT_RECORDED) and pass directly to build_seat_record(ctx).
defects.root_cause: Omission of an explicit execution context parameter in _seat_record helper function during RCA-2A.7 implementation.
defects.trigger: Runner loop constructed _seat_record without explicit parameter passing, relying on local closure state that was not uniformly initialized across error branches.

defects.name: Duplicate Readiness Probe Append on Interrupted Gate Recovery
defects.required_change: Implement execute_or_verify_readiness_probe with deterministic probe identity; read-only verification of existing sinks during gate recovery; exclusive 0600 file creation via create_exclusive_diagnostic_sink.
defects.root_cause: Sink file was opened in unconditional append mode ('a') without deterministic probe identity checking or read-only recovery validation.
defects.trigger: Re-running or recovering a preflight readiness check appended duplicate synthetic diagnostic records into the existing sink.

defects.name: Cross-Arm Canonical Input Disparity from Independent Orchestrator Seeds
defects.required_change: Implement cloned scratch store architecture (build_cloned_pair_fixtures) cloning the same post-delegation SQLite database into isolated physical files (pair-XX-control.db and pair-XX-treatment.db), proving canonical_control_hash == canonical_treatment_hash with identical projections, bindings, and exact guidance delta.
defects.root_cause: Independent synthetic orchestrator invocations produced ephemeral identity differences that prevented proving cross-arm byte parity.
defects.trigger: Control and treatment fixtures generated independently invoked the orchestrator with separate random run IDs, timestamps, and synthetic delegation UUIDs, creating divergent context, projection, and binding table hashes.

defects.name: Provider Exception vs Internal Runner Bug Misclassification
defects.required_change: Differentiate network/provider errors (is_provider_error_class, checking for timeout, connection, rate limit, status codes) from internal runner bugs (UNEXPECTED_EXCEPTION:<class>), ensuring internal crashes stop the run cleanly without disguising them as model or provider faults.
defects.root_cause: classify_provider_http_error defaulted non-status HTTP exceptions to PROVIDER_INFRA_FAILURE, and runner stop logic treated any non-empty provider_error_classes as a provider network failure.
defects.trigger: Internal Python exceptions (e.g. RuntimeError, KeyError) raised during execution were unconditionally attributed to provider failure in telemetry / stop conditions.

defects.affected_scope: Experiment matrix integrity and budget guarantees.
defects.name: Missing Explicit Seat Accounting Lifecycle & Stop-on-Failure Boundaries
defects.required_change: Strict 5-phase seat accounting; halt remaining seats immediately as NOT_STARTED with recorded stop_reason; enforce maximum budgets (8 invocations, 16 logical generations, 3 preflight requests).
defects.root_cause: Runner lacked explicit phase state machine and monotonic counter tracking for stage_invocations_started, stage_invocations_finished, and logical_model_generations.
defects.trigger: Partial failures or stop conditions left unstarted seats in an ambiguous state, risking double-counting or accidental continuation.

summary: All 5 identified defects have been remediated, structurally decoupled from production code, and verified by unit tests S1-S8 and E1-E14.
